5267-7924-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a Clue.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' second ability triggers, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2645-2872-3430-3478.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2872-3430-3478.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{B}{B}{B} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3899-4871-8168.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token with flying due to Draconic Visitor.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2169-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2169-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {U}{G}, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1232-4742-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-4742-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

104-4050-4772-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-4050-4772-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3534-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-3534-6158.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

104-2428-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Benthic Biomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3234-3293-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2438-3234-3293-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat
2438-3234-3293-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4017-4929-6805.description:
Activate Royal Herbalist by paying {2} and exiling the top card of your library, causing you to gain 1 life.
Cryptic Trilobite triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2866-3168-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2781-4702-6524.manaNeeded: {2}{R}{W}{B} if All-Out Assault is in your hand
2781-4702-6524.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2781-4702-6524.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare any creature as an attacker.
All-Out Assault triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Move to your next main phase.
Activate Felidar Guardian by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, Felidar Guardian triggers, blinking All-Out Assault.
Repeat from step 2.
2781-4702-6524.notes: If All-Out Assault is on the battlefield to start, skip to step 5 on the first iteration, and then follow the steps as listed. You also do not need mana to start the combo in this scenario.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-3334-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-3334-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-3075-3263-6577.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters
112-3075-3263-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

46-6452.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with enough mana to cast it.
You have enough mana to cast Refuse // Cooperate
46-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, copying the original Cooperate, with the copy targeting the original Cooperate.
Repeat step 5.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

5733-6333-6336.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-6333-6336.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng from your graveyard for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Haystack by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

3765-4761-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
3765-4761-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
3765-4761-6102.description:
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, allowing you to cast sorcery spells until end of turn as though they have flash.
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 2, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

413-719-1429-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-719-1429-5402.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1636-5996-6202.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5996-6202.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-5996-6202.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Noyan Dar triggers, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature with haste.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 3.

957-2707-5373.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Kylox's Voltstrider.
957-2707-5373.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your second extra turn.
Activate Kylox's Voltstrider's first ability by exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard, causing Kylox's Voltstrider to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Kylov's Voltstrider as an attacker.
Kylox's Voltstrider triggers, causing you to pay {8}{U}{U} to cast Time Stretch from exile.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one, and put Time Stretch on the bottom of your library.
Move to your first extra turn, drawing Time Stretch from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1219-1409-4221-4438-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Beledros.
"Cleric" chosen with Conspiracy.
1219-1409-4221-4438-4875.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Beledros by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Beledros enters the battlefield, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {2}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

647-1312-3770-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gixian Puppeteer, adding {B}.
When Gixian Puppeteer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Gixian Puppeteer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2399-3693-4314.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Colfenor and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of {C}, you may cast Walking Ballista using an arbitrarily large amount of mana, then use its ability to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
